body: b9ae35c brings the original's generator and wave placement, the fire timer, the ramguard port (VectorCraft cb29e7b), a regen of 147 fixtures at the tip, and a docs fix. The three intermediate commits were resolved under the regen-tip rule. Proposal: land branches in a fixed queue, and rebase each one only when it reaches the head, to avoid repeated 20-minute gates.
